name: MATP-Anonymous
description: MATP-Anonymous is a benchmark dataset measuring performance on mathematical/analytical problems presented in text form, focusing on problem-solving and reasoning over mathematical concepts. It evaluates models' ability to produce correct solutions and intermediate steps for a variety of math tasks. The dataset is intended for automated evaluation of reasoning and calculation accuracy under anonymized conditions.
reputation: A niche academic benchmark with limited but growing use in math-reasoning model evaluations.
